import os,stat,hashlib,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
base=Path('artifacts/evidence/TI3_TARGET_RESOLUTION')
for q in (base,*base.parents):assert not stat.S_ISLNK(q.lstat().st_mode)
codes=['resolve.py','run_resolution.py','test_resolution.py']
staged=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--cached','--name-only'],text=True).splitlines()
assert len(staged)==16 and not any(x.endswith('.py') for x in staged)
manifest=['original_local_path\tsnapshot_tracked_path\tsha256\tbyte_count']
rows=[]
for name in codes:
    p=base/name
    assert stat.S_ISREG(p.lstat().st_mode)
    b=p.read_bytes()
    snap=base/(name+'.snapshot.txt')
    with snap.open('xb') as f:f.write(b)
    assert snap.read_bytes()==b
    h=hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
    manifest.append(f'{p}\t{snap}\t{h}\t{len(b)}')
    rows.append({'original_local_path':str(p),'snapshot_tracked_path':str(snap),'sha256':h,'byte_count':len(b),'byte_identity':True})
with (base/'script-snapshots.sha256').open('x',encoding='utf-8') as f:f.write('\n'.join(manifest)+'\n')
ignored=subprocess.check_output(['git','check-ignore','--',*[str(base/n) for n in codes]],text=True).splitlines()
assert set(ignored)=={str(base/n) for n in codes}
print(json.dumps({'status':'PASS_SNAPSHOT_PRESERVATION','originals_local_and_ignored':True,'ordinary_texts_still_staged':len(staged),'snapshots':rows},indent=2))
